select interface_config.id as interface_id, interface_config.interface_name, interface_config.task_id, interface_config.host, interface_config.port, interface_config.multicast_ip, interface_config.transfer_type, interface_config.transfer_protocol, interface_config.rpc_enabled, interface_config.protocol_config_id, protocol_config.config_params as protocol_config_params, coalesce(rule_config.parameter_range_check_enabled, 0) as parameter_range_check_enabled from collect_interface_config interface_config left join collect_protocol_config protocol_config on protocol_config.id = interface_config.protocol_config_id and protocol_config.is_deleted = 0 and protocol_config.enabled = 1 left join processing_rule_config rule_config on rule_config.task_id = interface_config.task_id where interface_config.is_deleted = 0 and interface_config.enabled = 1
and interface_config.transfer_type in (1, 2)
and exists ( select 1 from experiment_task task_config where task_config.task_id = interface_config.task_id and task_config.task_status = 1 )
